answer: Grades that diverge from the quorum median are slashed, and the failure is published with the juror's address, the submission hash and the median it contradicted. Auditors come from a rotating pool, so a colluding panel cannot be assembled twice from the same names. The vault holds the bond until the epoch settles. A farm on the mesa has to assume its bad grades will be visible, and visibility turns a strategy that looks profitable for one epoch into a glacier of slow, repeated losses.
